title: Best Wireless Mouse (2026)
summary: The top wireless mice for 2026 combine productivity‑focused ergonomics with high‑performance gaming features.
method: Products were chosen from the four source articles (CNET, Tom's Guide, PCMag, RTings); picks that appear in more than one source were prioritized.
assumptions: Prices are shown only when explicitly stated in a source; otherwise price is null. No external data was added.

products.name: Logitech MX Master 3S Wireless Mouse
why: CNET tested and approved this mouse as the best wireless mouse overall, highlighting its flexible office‑use design and durability for Mac or Windows PCs.
It offers a high‑quality connection, ergonomic shape, and long battery life, making it suitable for power users.
cons: May be larger for small hands
products.best_for: Office power users and creatives who need precision and comfort
products.skip_if: You need a budget mouse under $20
